title: BOD PoseState v1 (bod.pose.v1, InMoov-class embodiment information)
description: One indexed embodiment record: quantized joint vector + per-servo fault mask + balance + location + provenance + checksums. Companion to BOD_EMBODIMENT_SPEC.md (living draft v0.2, 2026-10-13; renamed from WHI, BOD naming approved by the maintainers 2026-10-13). Non-commercial R&D; InMoov design (c) Gael Langevin, CC BY-NC. Hardware facts (channel names, servo refdes, limits) come from INMOOV_DESIGN_DOSSIER.md v0.2 and the local inmoov/inmoov2 clones; nothing here adds hardware facts. pose_id and joint_checksum are computed by the deterministic BOD validator, never by the LLM.

body_profile.description: Which channel list and fault-mask layout applies. finger_starter_v1 = 1 channel / 1 servo (SVO00). right_arm_v1 = 10 channels / 10 servos (SVO01-SVO10). classic31_v1 = 28 MRL channels / 31 physical servos (SVO01-SVO31). See spec section 2.2.

calibration_id.description: Identifier of the calibration register / MRL config set (map, rest, inverted, limits) in force. Part of the canonical payload: the same degrees under a different calibration are a different physical pose. Source of truth is dossier OPEN-Q2.

pose_id.description: 'BP1-' + first 16 lowercase hex chars of checksums.joint_checksum (SHA-256 of the canonical payload, spec section 2.8).

pose_name.description: Optional canonical library name, e.g. 'rest', 'ready', 'point_center_right', or a fault-augmented name such as 'ready+RA_offline'.

joint_vector.description: One entry per MRL channel, in the canonical order of the body_profile (spec section 2.2). Degrees are MRL INPUT-domain degrees (the units gestures use, before map()).

bin_deg.description: Grid step in input degrees. v1 proposal = 5.

rounding.description: half_up toward the nearest grid point, then clamp to the channel's input limits.

fault_mask.description: One digit per PHYSICAL servo in refdes order of the body_profile (classic31_v1: SVO01..SVO31; right_arm_v1: SVO01..SVO10; finger_starter_v1: SVO00). Codes: 0 ok, 1 weak, 2 stuck, 3 disconnected, 4 unknown, 5 offline (intentionally disabled / de-powered), 6 absent (not installed yet).

limbs.description: Roll-up per subassembly: worst servo code in that limb, as a word.

modifiers.description: Malfunction / disrepair modifiers active on this state (spec section 7).

target.description: Channel name, refdes (SVOnn) or limb name.

estop.description: Physical servo-rail kill switch SW1 state (dossier 4.5, 8.2).

support_note.description: Mount / support polygon note. Classic InMoov low stomach is a pole mount (dossier 5.2); stand geometry is not yet defined (spec OPEN-W5).

model.description: Which balance estimator produced this. v0 = rule table with placeholder thresholds; no mass model exists yet.

overall.description: Weakest provenance among joints that are not absent/offline.

encoder.description: MRL encoder in use. Default is TimeEncoder (speed x time estimate, dossier 1.5).

canonical_payload.description: Exact UTF-8 string that was hashed (spec 2.8). Stored so any reader can re-verify.

record_checksum.description: Optional SHA-256 over the whole record minus this field, for storage integrity.

sequence_checksum.description: Present when this state is an expected step inside a MotionPlan (spec 8).

contact.description: Optional finger pressure/contact levels 0-3 per fingertip sensor (dossier 1.7: J_SensorFinger levels; thresholds must be re-measured, OPEN-Q3).

name.description: MRL channel name without the 'i01.' prefix, e.g. 'rightHand.index', 'head.rollNeck', 'torso.topStom'.

svo.description: Physical servo refdes driven by this channel (dossier 8.2). Paired channels list two.

q_deg.description: Quantized input-domain angle used in the canonical payload; null when the joint position is unknown (disconnected/offline/absent/unknown with no trustworthy estimate).

estimated_deg.description: MRL currentInputPos from the encoder in use; with TimeEncoder this is a speed x time model, not a measurement.

sensed_deg.description: Only from a real sensor (AS5048A/AMT203 encoder or a future pot tap). Null on stock InMoov.

energized.description: false after autoDisable idleTimeout (default 3000 ms, dossier 1.4).
